name: Diabolical Mantle

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Your body takes on the essence of the ten Hells. You gain greater darkvision, immunity to fire, resistance 5 to physical damage (except silver) and poison damage, and weakness 5 to holy. Damage you deal has the unholy trait. Once during the duration, you can cast 4th-rank Translocate as a divine innate spell.

Spell Effect: Diabolical Mantle
